Class MapPlaces

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.MapPlaces
public final class MapPlaces extends Object
Places on the world map (API version 7). A plugin registers a kind of place; everything else is Core's: each kind gets a tab in /tempest (on or off, icon, colour, name, size, compass, who sees it, how far away, which worlds), every place can be changed or hidden from /places, and each player picks which kinds their map shows.

On a server, blocks that stood there before a kind was added show once someone uses them. 

// Blocks: Core remembers each one when it is placed or used, and forgets it when it goes
core.mapKind(new MapPlaces.Kind("dragon_nest", "Dragon nests", Message.translation("server.dragons.map.nest"))
        .icon("Tempest_Star.png").color("#E74C3C").item("Rock_Gem_Ruby")
        .blocks(id -> id.equals("Dragon_Nest")));

// Or your own list, asked for every few seconds (keep it quick, it runs on any thread)
core.mapKind(new MapPlaces.Kind("dragon", "Dragons", Message.translation("server.dragons.map.dragon"))
        .places(() -> dragons.stream().map(d -> new MapPlaces.Place(d.id(), d.world(), d.x(), d.y(), d.z(), d.name())).toList()));
After a change that should show at once, call refresh().
